question: Did Mary remain a virgin all her life?

answers.label: Yes: Mary remained a virgin; Jesus' "brothers" were relatives
No: after Jesus she had other children by Joseph

overview.text: By about 150 the Protoevangelium of James made Jesus' "brothers" Joseph's sons by an earlier wife. Origen reports this and calls Mary the first fruits of virginity among women; by Athanasius "Ever-Virgin" is a title.
Some held that Mary and Joseph had children afterward; Epiphanius and Jerome wrote against them. Catholic and Orthodox churches teach her perpetual virginity, as did the first Reformers.

quotes.author: Origen of Alexandria
quotes.english: Some say, basing it on a tradition in the Gospel according to Peter, as it is called, or the Book of James, that the brothers of Jesus were sons of Joseph by a former wife who lived with him before Mary. Those who say this want to keep the honor of Mary in virginity to the end, so that the body chosen to serve the word "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you" should not know a man's bed after the Holy Spirit came upon her. And I think it reasonable that Jesus was the first fruits of purity in chastity among men, and Mary among women; for it would not be fitting to give the first fruits of virginity to any woman but her.
quotes.original: Τοὺς δὲ ἀδελφοὺς Ἰησοῦ φασί τινες εἶναι, ἐκ παραδόσεως ὁρμώμενοι τοῦ ἐπιγεγραμμένου κατὰ Πέτρον εὐαγγελίου ἢ τῆς βίβλου Ἰακώβου, υἱοὺς Ἰωσὴφ ἐκ προτέρας γυναικὸς συνῳκηκυίας αὐτῷ πρὸ τῆς Μαρίας. Οἱ δὲ ταῦτα λέγοντες τὸ ἀξίωμα τῆς Μαρίας ἐν παρθενίᾳ τηρεῖν μέχρι τέλους βούλονται, ἵνα μὴ τὸ κριθὲν ἐκεῖνο σῶμα διακονήσασθαι τῷ εἰπόντι λόγῳ· «Πνεῦμα ἅγιον ἐπελεύσεται ἐπί σε καὶ δύναμις ὑψίστου ἐπισκιάσει σοι», γνῷ κοίτην ἀνδρὸς μετὰ τὸ ἐπελθεῖν ἐν αὐτῇ πνεῦμα ἅγιον καὶ τὴν ἐπεσκια κυῖαν αὐτῇ δύναμιν ἐξ ὕψους. Καὶ οἶμαι λόγον ἔχειν ἀνδρῶν μὲν καθαρότητος τῆς ἐν ἁγνείᾳ ἀπαρχὴν γεγονέναι τὸν Ἰησοῦν, γυναικῶν δὲ τὴν Μαρίαν· οὐ γὰρ εὔφημον ἄλλῃ παρ' ἐκείνην τὴν ἀπαρχὴν τῆς παρθενίας ἐπιγράψασθαι.
quotes.context: The "Book of James" is the Protoevangelium of James (about 150). Origen gives the tradition and his own view, but notes it is a tradition, not Scripture.

quotes.author: Athanasius of Alexandria
quotes.english: ... let them also deny that he took true human flesh from Mary the Ever-Virgin.
quotes.original: ἀρνείσθωσαν καὶ ἀληθινὴν σάρκα ἀνθρωπίνην αὐτὸν εἰληφέναι ἐκ Μαρίας τῆς ἀειπαρθένου.
quotes.context: "Ever-Virgin" (aeiparthenos) used as a title in passing, about 340.

quotes.author: Antidicomarianites (as Epiphanius reports)
quotes.english: ... those who say that holy Mary, the ever-virgin, was united with Joseph after she had borne the Savior, whom we have called Antidicomarianites ("opponents of Mary").
quotes.original: οἱ καὶ τὴν ἁγίαν Μαρίαν τὴν ἀειπαρθένον λέγοντες μετὰ τὸ τὸν σωτῆρα γεγεννηκέναι τῷ Ἰωσὴφ συνῆφθαι, οὕστινας ἐκαλέσαμεν Ἀντιδικομαριαμίτας
quotes.context: A group in Arabia who held that Mary had other children by Joseph. Helvidius held the same at Rome about 383.

quotes.author: Catechism of the Catholic Church
quotes.english: The deepening of faith in the virginal motherhood led the Church to confess Mary's real and perpetual virginity even in the act of giving birth to the Son of God made man.
quotes.original: The deepening of faith in the virginal motherhood led the Church to confess Mary's real and perpetual virginity even in the act of giving birth to the Son of God made man.
quotes.context: Catholic and Orthodox teaching. Luther, Zwingli and Calvin also held Mary's perpetual virginity.

quotes.author: Synod of Jerusalem (Orthodox)
quotes.english: being conceived of the Holy Spirit, in the womb of the ever-virgin Mary
quotes.original: being conceived of the Holy Spirit, in the womb of the ever-virgin Mary
quotes.context: The Orthodox use the title in every liturgy.

source.edition: Confession of Dositheus (Synod of Jerusalem), Decree 7 (1672)

gaps.author: Jerome
gaps.why: The brothers as cousins, against Helvidius.

gaps.author: Tertullian
gaps.work: On the Flesh of Christ 23; On Monogamy 8
gaps.why: Tertullian seems to have thought Mary bore other children. In the library; to be read.

gaps.author: Protoevangelium of James
gaps.why: The oldest source for Joseph as an older widower.
